verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is a SaaS cap table platform that holds sensitive company data and offers an AI assistant integration over MCP, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack has no AI-training policy, opt-out control, or data-use commitment. The MCP docs only say AI assistants can read the user's cap table in read-only mode, which is about access, not whether Cake trains models on customer data.
